sections.h2: Salem Lakes Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 101 residential sales closed in Salem Lakes (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $385,000, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 12 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Salem Lakes sales closed between $323,464 and $401,000, or about $244 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($395,000, 57 sales) was about 10% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($360,000, 44 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Salem Lakes sales were in ZIP code 23456.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Salem Lakes
sections.html: 28% of Salem Lakes sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. 49% of Salem Lakes homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood. 60% of Salem Lakes homes went under contract within 14 days of listing, compared with 49% of Virginia Beach sales overall.

sections.h2: When Salem Lakes Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Salem Lakes were busiest in June (14 sales across the two years) and slowest in January (3 sales). Sold prices ran from $200,000 to $499,900, a spread of 2.5x between the lowest and highest sale. 85% of homes closed at or above list price and 4% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Salem Lakes
sections.html:
74% of the sales were detached homes and 26% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,484 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,290 to 1,700 square feet. 63% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1983 and 1986, with a median year built of 1984, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
